title: 받아쓰기 5: 콧소리·흐름소리
objective: You can say 국물 [궁물], 음료 [음뇨], and 설날 [설랄] and write them correctly.
summary: When certain consonants meet ㄴ, ㅁ, or ㄹ, one of them changes into a nasal sound ([ㅇ], [ㅁ], [ㄴ]) or [ㄹ].

task.title: Hear, say, and write
task.line: Say each word out loud, use the rules on page 1, and write the sound in [ ] or the correct spelling.

words.exampleMeaning: I go to my hometown on Lunar New Year.

letters.as: Before n or m, a final k sound becomes ng, and a final p sound becomes m.
After m or ng, the next ㄹ sounds like n.
n and l together become a long l, like 'all leaves'.

exercises: Write how each word sounds: ① 작년 ② 입니다 ③ 한라산
You hear the sound in [ ]. Write the correct spelling: ① [궁민] (people of a country) ② [실래] (indoors)
Write the correct spelling of the sound in [ ]: ① 학교에 [감니다]. ② [날로]를 켜요.
Choose the word that has a nasal or [ㄹ] sound change, then write its sound: ① 물냉면 / 비빔냉면 ② 밥상 / 밥만
